Most small to medium sized businesses that generate revenues in excess of BDT 3 crores annually, don’t know each other, they don’t have direct online access to their customers, and often resort to endless meetings and/or friends of friends based networking to get business. Their company websites are severely lacking reach and these companies don’t historically know how to secure business online. Even BASIS, REHAB and BGMEA websites are non-interactive and look like they are stuck in 2010. The problem is clear: asymmetric business information, poor online presence, and lack of clustering. ContractorPlaza fixes that, and gets a share of the business in the middle + subscription fees.

Founder Unfair Advantage:
At the age of 35, I have the right mix of experience in business, government relations and corporate to understand the glaring problem: the lack of an online clustered business hub. I have personally experienced the problems that business owners face.
